feeding_claim.verbatim: After grazing on pasture, our grain-finished cattle enjoy a 90-day finishing process where we feed daily from locally-sourced grains.

availability.note: Both beef share products and the freezer add-on are marked sold out in the online store.

notes: Angus beef sold as quarter, half and whole shares in two lines, Grass Fed, Grass Finished and Grass Fed, Grain Finished, so category both. Farm address 3371 Jackson Rd, Camp Hill (Tallapoosa County, near Auburn) is on the site but left non-public. Beef is picked up frozen at the farm at scheduled times. No delivery or shipping details; contact by email or phone.
